content: {"summary":"In June 2026 the surge of external traffic hit the edge gateway’s local rate‑limit rule for the `/search` route, causing every edge pod to return `EDGE‑RL01` 429 responses and drop search requests.","likely_cause":"The per‑pod `/search` rate‑limit rule (250 req/s per pod, 750 req/s total) in the edge‑gateway Envoy config was exceeded.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Each edge pod enforces a local bucket of 250 requests per second for the `/search` route.","evidence_ids":["INC-0167#1"],"quote":"set to 250 requests per second per pod"},{"text":"All three edge pods logged `EDGE‑RL01` 429 responses at the same time, indicating the rule tripped across the board.","evidence_ids":["INC-0167#0","RB-030#2"],"quote":"All three edge pods (-01, -02 and -03) logged it"},{"text":"The rate‑limit settings are stored in the ConfigMap `edge-gateway-envoy` and read by Envoy at startup.","evidence_ids":["RB-030#3"],"quote":"The limiter's settings live in the ConfigMap `edge-gateway-envoy`"}],"next_checks":["Verify the current per‑pod `/search` rate‑limit values in the `edge-gateway-envoy` ConfigMap","Monitor the `enforced` counter on each edge pod via Envoy admin stats to detect future bucket exhaustion","Assess whether the 250 rps per‑pod limit is sufficient for expected traffic spikes","Confirm ownership and review schedule for updating edge rate‑limit rules"]}
